title: UI重构；更新README
body:
对项目的用户界面进行了系统性重构，同时引入了新的开源组件——HarmonyOS Sans SC。
对项目的README进行了内容与排版优化，以帮助新用户快速上手该项目。

title: fix: 修复“运行日志”模块显示问题并优化临时日志清除逻辑与报错提示
body:
“运行日志”页面会出现模块内不显示内容的情况，因全局 TextBox 样式为 Height=40，而日志页的 BareTextBox 未进行覆盖。

修复显示问题：
- 正确覆盖了全局TextBox样式

优化日志行为：
- 用户切换页面不会导致当前任务的日志丢失
- 失败时日志会追加 `任务失败：退出码 N，未生成 <输出路径>`

项目UX优化：
- 引入了全新的引导页，用户进入软件将直接进入引导页而非DVD参数选项

title: refactor：优化“实时预览”的体验逻辑；固化部分参数字段
body:
项目存在多处冗余设计，集中于 CD / DVD 盘片生成页面的预览校准模块与部分参数字段

**部分参数固化，减少不必要的参数暴露，降低学习成本：**
- 删除 CD 的线速度、起始角、图片外半径参数：分别固定为 1200 mm/s、0°、57.5 mm
- 删除 DVD 的 Channel bit、起始角参数：分别固定为 133.33 nm、0°
- 界面与预设 JSON均不再暴露
- **旧版用户预设文件会被拒绝并回退内置预设！**

**实时预览页引入了读回模拟模式，精简了标定逻辑，清晰页面职责：**
- 读回模拟的输入为生成产物（CD 为 WAV/RAW 音轨，DVD 为 ISO 镜像）
- 由于输入更改为了盘片生成产物，仅保留了一套盘片几何参数用于标定实测盘面
- CD 复用 cd-preview-track 命令渲染音轨读回
- DVD 引擎新增 simulate 命令：读取 ISO payload，经扰码分类黑/白码字后按实测半径投影

**删除窗口底部状态栏，集中信息：**
- 准备/完成/失败状态与流式刻录进度不再跳转到全局底栏
- 原先只存在于底栏的"打开输出位置"移到运行日志页标题栏

**其他的杂项优化：**
- CD WAV 输出增加 CUE 导出可选项
- 抽出可复用的 HelpHint 悬停问号控件以减少重复代码
- 对实时预览页面的渲染与导出选项进行了集中
- 优化或删减了“制作盘片”与“实时预览”页面的部分文档表述

title: 工作区与工程存储重构；引入盘面设计流程
body:
对工作区进行了概念整理与重构

**引入工作区模型**
- 引入工作区模型（主页/设计/预览/导出/刻录/标定六个流程）；
- 新增 .discproj 工程文件概念；
- 面板控件体系统一（StageBar/MonitorCard/StepCard/PathField/JobDock 等）。

**引入“影调”参数概念**
- 抖动强度（0–100%）：大致决定对比度；
- 灰阶档位（2/4 级）： 大致决定细节丰富度；
- 亮度（±64）：大致决定亮度；
- sRGB 线性化（伽马）：大致决定对比度。

**“设计”流程引入与统一管道搭建**
- 支持高定制度的手动盘面设计；
- 参数归属随管道清晰化。

**其他的杂项优化**

title: 界面信息密度收紧；新建工程对话框打磨；设计页画布缩放
body:
本次项目界面打磨集中于新建工程对话框、工程设置与设计页画布。

**新建工程对话框改为模板卡片浏览器，减少参数暴露与滚动负担：**
- 左栏改为「最近 / CD / DVD / 蓝光」四个文字页签，卡片网格列出该分类的全部非手动预设
- 右栏为「预设详细信息」

**工程设置对话框接入预设列表，同盘型参数可换用：**
- 编辑模式不再隐藏预设列，改为只列出当前盘型的预设；选择其他预设会覆盖当前几何。
- 保存预设时不再填写注释；保存后列表即时刷新并保持高亮

**设计页画布支持缩放与平移：**
- 右下角常驻「− / 百分比 / + / 适应窗口」工具栏
- 可缩放范围 25%–1200%。
- Ctrl/Alt + 滚轮以光标为锚点缩放，中键拖动平移（盘心不会拖出视野），双击空白处复位

**统一界面密度与主题色：**
- 字号与间距收紧。
- 圆角与高度收紧。
- 主题蓝统一为深色 `#3385FF` / 浅色强调 `#74C0FF`

**其他的杂项优化：**
- 内置预设改名为「标准 80min CD」「标准 12cm 单层 DVD」「标准 25GB 单层 BD」等
- 主页模板卡片灰字只写盘型，不再重复扇区与半径数字
- 随盘文件的位置选项从导出页收回设计页，导出页只保留输出文件与卷标
- 任务坞日志栏样式打磨
- README 行文结构重排，.NET 徽章修正为 10.0

title: 新增浅色主题与设置窗口；缓存和默认工程位置可配置
body:
项目原仅有深色主题，缓存固定写入系统临时目录，外观与存储偏好没有入口；本次引入即时主题切换与设置窗口，把工作站偏好从工程文件中分离出来。

**新增浅色／跟随系统主题，切换即时生效：**
- 代码侧取色的控件（侧边栏、分段控件、帮助问号、盘面画布、标定照片画布、任务坞）订阅变化后重读令牌或重绘
- 「跟随系统」读取 `HKCU\...\Themes\Personalize\AppsUseLightTheme`

**新增设置窗口，入口收进标题栏应用菜单：**
- 标题栏最小化按钮左侧新增「…」菜单，含「设置…」与「关于…」；原侧边栏底部的「关于」入口移除
- 设置分「通用」「存储」：主题；默认工程位置、缓存位置、缓存占用与清空、打开应用数据目录
- 设置持久化到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DiscImageStudio\settings.json`，camelCase、字符串枚举、临时文件原子替换；缺失、损坏或更高 schema 的文件回落到默认值，设置不写入 `.discproj`
- 保存前只修改副本，取消或 Esc 丢弃全部编辑
- 任务运行期间「清空缓存」按钮禁用

**缓存目录可配置，清理按白名单：**
- 设计合成图、缩略图与预览图写入设置中的缓存位置；留空回落系统临时目录，切换只影响新任务，旧缓存不迁移
- 配置时先创建目录并写探针验证可写，不可用则回落临时目录并提示

**默认工程位置接入新建工程对话框：**
- 设置中的默认工程位置作为新建工程对话框的初始目录；留空或目录失效时回落到系统文档目录

**其他杂项优化：**
- 最近工程路径与过长的预设名称共用同一套悬停滚动，预设卡名称被裁切时提供完整 tooltip
- 分段控件选中标签改用 `OnPrimaryColor`；标题栏省略号图标与项目保存高光改为颜色令牌
- README 与 ARCHITECTURE、CHANGELOG 同步更新

title: feat: add Japanese UI localization
body:
Follow-up to #17, as suggested in https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/pull/17#issuecomment-6574827644 — this adds Japanese (`ja`) as a fourth UI language on top of the v1.3.4 i18n foundation.

## Changes

- **Catalogs**: added `ja` text to all 734 entries in `Common.json`, `Workflows.json`, `Workspace.json`, `Xaml.json`. Argument indices / format specifiers (`{0}`, `{1:N0}`, `{0:HH:mm:ss}` …) match `zh-CN` for every entry (checked with a script).
- **Language resolution** (`L.cs`): new `L.Japanese = "ja"`; `ja` / `ja-*` normalize to `ja`, and a Japanese system UI culture now resolves to Japanese when following the system (previously English).
- **Settings**: `日本語` added to the language selector as index 4 (`SettingsViewModel` + `SettingsWindow.xaml`).
- **ui-snapshot**: `--language` accepts `ja`.
- **Tests**: `LocalizationTests` checks `ja` completeness/arguments, Japanese normalization/resolution, Japanese initialization and numeric-culture isolation, and includes `ja` in the save/cancel/failed-save choices; `AppSettingsTests` covers `ja` / `ja-JP` round-trips. The previous assertion "ja-JP system → English" is changed to `fr-FR`/`ko-KR`.
- **Docs**: `docs/LOCALIZATION.md`, the three READMEs and `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) mention Japanese.
- **README.ja.md**: new Japanese README translated from the current README (using 記録面 consistently), with a 日本語 link added to the language switcher of every README. This supersedes the older translation in #17.

## Notes

- I could not run `dotnet test` or `ui-snapshot` on Windows, so CI and a quick visual check would be appreciated (some Japanese strings may be longer than the Chinese ones).
- Language names in the selector are kept as endonyms (简体中文 / 繁體中文 / English / 日本語).

2. Disc surface terminology: レーベル面 refers to the label side, whereas this application creates artwork on the recording surface. Please use 記録面 or ディスク面 consistently.
3. System-language hint: The Settings hint still says non-Chinese system languages use English. Please update all four translations to include Japanese before the English fallback.

The core localization implementation looks sound. These are the remaining issues identified by the AI review.

1. **Calibration toolbar clipping**: shortened the Japanese toolbar labels to noun forms matching the English style: 全体表示 / 書き込みパターン / 補正プレビュー / フィット曲線 (previously …を表示 / …を重ねて表示).

title: Keep file extensions when shortening ISO9660/Joliet names
body:
## Problem

When a CD/DVD/BD data image is built from a folder, file names longer than the identifier limits (31 characters for ISO9660, 60 for Joliet) are cut from the end, so the **extension is lost**. For example:

```
A photo taken on a very long summer holiday by the sea in the year 2025.jpg
```

is written to the disc's Joliet tree (what Windows Explorer shows) as

```
A photo taken on a very long summer holiday by the sea in ;1
```

with no `.jpg`, so Windows no longer associates it with an app. Collision discriminators had the same effect: they were appended *after* the extension (`PHOTO.JPG~2;1`, `…sea i~2;1`).

## Fix

`MakeUnique` now shortens the stem instead of the whole name and puts the `~N` discriminator before the extension:

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| `A photo taken … by the sea in ;1` | `A photo taken … by the sea.jpg;1` |
| `A photo taken … by the sea i~2;1` | `A photo taken … by the s~2.jpg;1` |
| `A_B.PDF~2;1` | `A_B~2.PDF;1` |

- Names that already fit are byte-for-byte unchanged, so existing layouts are unaffected.
- Extensions longer than 8 characters (including the dot), names starting with a dot, and directories keep the previous plain truncation.
- Trailing dots/spaces are trimmed from a shortened stem.

## Tests

New `IsoIdentifierTests` builds an ISO from a folder of long, colliding and unusual names and reads both the primary and Joliet root directories back from the image. On the original writer it fails with `shortened long Joliet names keep their extension: A photo taken on a very long summer holiday by the sea in ;1 | …sea i~2;1`; with this change the full `DiscImageStudio.ArchitectureTests` run passes locally on Windows (`architecture-selftest: all checks passed`), including the existing CD, DVD and Blu-ray ISO/Joliet tests.

nodes.body:
Thanks for fixing the lost extensions. I compared images from `main` and this PR. The new tests pass, but I found three naming regressions I’d like to see fixed before merging.

1. **A shortened name can take another file’s original path.** Let `S` be 54 `a` characters and put `S.jpg` and `S (copy).jpg` in the same folder. The copy sorts first and gets the Joliet name `S.jpg`. Opening that path now returns the copy’s contents, while the original is renamed to `S~2.jpg`. Please reserve names that already fit before assigning shortened aliases. A regression test should give the two files different contents and check what each path opens.
2. **Short names are trimmed even when they already fit.** With both `report .pdf` and `report.pdf`, the Joliet entry `report.pdf` now contains the first file’s data, and the original `report.pdf` becomes `report~2.pdf`. Please apply `TrimEnd('.', ' ')` only when the stem was actually shortened.
3. **The primary tree can expose duplicate names to readers.** Let `Z` be 28 `z` characters and add both `Z` and `Z.longextension`. The fallback truncates the second name immediately after the dot. With Joliet disabled, `bsdtar` lists the same path twice. On `main`, the second entry gets a `~2` suffix. Please handle the trailing dot before checking uniqueness.

One small clarification: the description says leading-dot names keep the old truncation behavior, but a long `.hidden….cfg` now preserves `.cfg`. If that’s intended, updating the description is enough.

I’d keep the directory-ordering work in #33 separate. Reordering records after name assignment won’t restore a path that was already assigned to the wrong file.

title: Add experimental macOS desktop with shared generation and calibration
body:
## Problem and behavior

macOS has the offline CLI but no graphical project workflow. This adds an experimental Avalonia desktop following the Windows workspace sequence, using the shared `.discproj` format, optical modules and Core calibration algorithms.

- Home/presets/recent projects, native file dialogs, unsaved-change protection and keyboard shortcuts.
- Layer editing with immediate cached drag/scale/rotation, synchronized property fields, shared tone controls and original-resolution 8192px export composites.
- Design/artifact previews and pure/mixed-file CD/DVD/BD generation, including protected-file overlays, artifact sidecars, calibrated pitch coefficients and DVD read compatibility.
- Photo calibration with editable boundaries, perspective correction, radial traces, fitting/candidates and a confirmed prediction before applying parameters. Blank-space dragging pans the photo. CD reference artwork and its frozen record use matching geometry.
- Mac DiscRecording artifact writes through `drutil`: blank/capacity checks, a 150-sector first-track audio allowance, lossless WAV-to-AIFF conversion, and live device percentages in the dock and log. Completion requires the tool's success acknowledgement.
- Vector branding/icons, light/dark themes and scrollable controls that remain reachable above the job log.
- Self-contained Intel/Apple Silicon app packaging, signature checks, native snapshots and portable regression tests in CI.

Merged upstream main through `c720fd4` and resolved the changelog conflict. The Mac adapters retain upstream pitch/read-compatibility settings and explicitly identify their reference calibration artwork. WPF/IMAPI and optical encoders remain shared; conditional PNG I/O enables the existing BD renderer and file-region overlay in the portable shell.

## Validation

- Full solution cross-build: zero warnings/errors.
- Portable desktop suite: **85 checks passed on macOS**, covering generation/preview, project round trips, file payloads/overlays, PCM preservation, media checks, live terminal progress before process exit, immediate canvas transforms, focused-field/page scrolling and calibration dragging.
- Integration regressions verify CD/BD pitch-aware export/readback, DVD compatibility persistence, and byte equality between a desktop-generated CD calibration WAV and its frozen Core target.
- DVD selftest passed.
- Self-contained Apple Silicon package built and signature verified; all six native workspace snapshots rendered and inspected.
- [CI for head `e30dfec`, attempt 2](https://github.com/Vel044/DiscImageStudio/actions/runs/42261454600/attempts/2): **all seven jobs passed** — Windows build/architecture/desktop/DVD/WPF checks, Intel and Apple Silicon Mac desktop tests/packages/native snapshots, and all four CLI platforms. The two Apple Silicon jobs were initially cancelled before execution because GitHub could not allocate hosted runners; retrying those jobs completed successfully without source changes.

## Physical CD evidence and remaining limits

On 2026-11-06, before the upstream integration, CD audio recording was exercised on a Lenovo Slim_USB_Burner DD11 with HONGQI CD-R 700 MB / 80 min / 52x media. A 359,600-sector payload completed with live percentages and closure confirmation. Seven 16-sector readback windows matched the exported PCM. The user confirmed visible artwork after calibration and confirmed their workflow worked. This is sampled verification of one hardware combination; the newly integrated encoders have automated coverage but no additional physical burn.

The PR remains a draft for maintainer feedback. Mac recording exports a complete artifact first; IMAPI-style streaming and BD writing are unavailable. DVD hardware validation is pending. New Windows coarse/boundary/clock calibration workflows and cache-location settings are not exposed. Mac-specific translations remain incomplete. App bundles are ad-hoc signed and not notarized.

See [docs/MACOS_DESKTOP.md](docs/MACOS_DESKTOP.md) for operation, the parity matrix and reproducible validation. App bundles, personal artwork/photos and generated optical outputs are excluded from this source PR.

title: Fix CD DAO burns failing with 0xC0AA0301 by preferring raw P-W subchannel
body:
## 摘要

CD 流式刻录（音轨与数据盘 DAO）此前固定使用 IMAPI 的 Cooked R-W 子通道格式（`IMAPI_FORMAT2_RAW_CD_SUBCODE_IS_COOKED`）。部分刻录机虽然在 `SupportedSectorTypes` 中列出该格式，实际却拒绝写入，刻录在写导入区时立即失败并返回 `0xC0AA0301`。本 PR 改为：刻录机支持时使用 Raw P-W（`IMAPI_FORMAT2_RAW_CD_SUBCODE_IS_RAW`），否则保留 Cooked R-W。

## 问题与根因

- **现象**：HP BD-RE BU20N（HL-DT-ST，固件 0403，USB 连接）配联想 Thinkplus CD-R 80min，v1.3.6 流式刻录在“正在写入 CD 导入区”后立即失败：`Windows 刻录接口在“写入 CD DAO 音轨”时返回错误 0xC0AA0301`。盘片容量足够（ATIP 79:59:70，即 359,845 扇区；实际刻录 359,840 扇区），失败后盘片仍为空白盘。
- **驱动器报告**：该盘的 `SupportedSectorTypes` 为 `[1, 2, 3]`，所以现有的支持性检查能通过。
- **复现**：用独立 SCSI 工具做模拟刻录（Test Write，不烧录数据区）。MMC 写入类型 RAW + 数据块类型 2（Cooked/packed R-W）时，驱动器接受 MODE SELECT，但导入区起点的第一个 `WRITE(10)` 即返回 sense `5/64/00`（ILLEGAL MODE FOR THIS TRACK）。4× 与 16× 结果相同，与速度无关。IMAPI 将其报告为 `E_IMAPI_UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE_FROM_DEVICE`（`0xC0AA0301`）。
- **对照**：同一张盘上，RAW + 数据块类型 3（Raw P-W）以 4× 连续接受了前 3,000 个导入区扇区；SAO（cue sheet）方式也能正常写入。
- **为什么可以直接切换**：内存实验表明，`MsftRawCDImageCreator` 在 `ResultingImageType` 为 2 和 3 时生成的镜像逐字节相同，R-W 为空。改用 Raw P-W 不改变盘面内容，只改变告知刻录机的子通道布局。cdrecord 文档也推荐 raw96r，而非 raw96p。

## 改动内容

**`src/DiscImageStudio.Burning`**

- `WindowsImapiBurner.BurnCdDao`：只读取一次 `SupportedSectorTypes`，由新增的 `ResolveCdDaoSectorType` 选择类型。
  - 优先 Raw P-W（3），否则回退 Cooked R-W（2）。
  - 两者都不支持（例如只有 PQ）时，在写入前报错并释放已准备的介质。
  - 选中的类型同时用于 `SetRequestedSectorType` 和镜像构造。
- 新增可选的 `reportDiagnostic` 回调。刻录日志会记录一行，例如 `CD DAO 子通道格式：Raw P-W（IMAPI 类型 3）；光驱报告支持：1, 2, 3。`
- `ICdRawImageSession.CreateImage(content, sectorType)`：类型由调用方显式传入。`DynamicCdRawImageSession` 在 `AddTrack`/`CreateResultImage` 之前设置 `ResultingImageType`，并拒绝 2448 字节以外的格式（PQ_ONLY 为 2368 字节）。
- `CdDataRawImageSession`（CD 数据盘 DAO）把同一类型传给模板镜像。它的子通道处理只改 P/Q、原样保留 R-W，两种 96 字节布局都适用。
- 新增 `CdRawSectorType` 常量，取代原来分散的两处硬编码 `2`。

**`tests/DiscImageStudio.ArchitectureTests`**

- 模拟刻录机可配置报告的扇区类型，并记录实际请求的类型和镜像类型。
- 新增覆盖：
  - 优先 Raw P-W；
  - 回退 Cooked R-W；
  - 仅 PQ 或空列表时拒绝，且不写入、释放介质；
  - 支持列表只读取一次；
  - 日志行内容；
  - 数据盘 DAO 路径的类型传递。
- 原生 IMAPI 内存测试：
  - 两种类型的完整镜像逐字节相同，且 R-W 为空；
  - 请求的类型确实到达 `IRawCDImageCreator`；
  - 字节序测试和数据盘镜像测试对两种类型都执行。

**文档**

- `CHANGELOG.md` 的 Unreleased 段（中英双语）、`docs/VALIDATION.md`、`docs/CD_AUDIO_COMPATIBILITY.md`。

## 行为变化

- 报告支持 Raw P-W 的刻录机改用 Raw P-W；只报告 Cooked R-W 的刻录机行为不变。
- 写入盘面的数据不变（镜像逐字节相同）。
- 两种格式都不支持时，错误信息会列出光驱报告的类型。

## 验证

以下结果均在 rebase 到当前 main（`507cac7`）后的提交上重新得到（.NET SDK 10.0.403，Windows，Release）：

- `dotnet build DiscImageStudio.slnx --configuration Release`：0 警告、0 错误。
- `dotnet run --project src/DvdImageSolver --configuration Release -- selftest`：通过。
- `dotnet run --project tests/DiscImageStudio.ArchitectureTests --configuration Release`：全部通过，包括 main 新增的 `cd-burn-phase-diagnostics`，以及本 PR 的 Raw P-W 相关检查（`cd-data-dao-workflow`、`cd-data-raw-image`、`cd-raw-image-byte-order`）。
- 自包含单文件 win-x64 发布按 `packaging/Build-Release.ps1` 的检查项冒烟通过：`burn-build-info`（`Raw CD DAO writer present: True`）、应用 `selftest`、两扇区 RAW（4704 字节）/WAV（4748 字节）/CUE、`--cue false`、`ui-snapshot`。
- **VALIDATION.md 回归项**：本 PR 改动流式刻录。已对照"CD 图片导出、音轨直接刻录""CD Mode 1 文件盘、流式刻录""流式刻录显示"和"CD 数据 DAO"各项复核：生成字节、CIRC 位置、进度与诊断行为不变，只改变告知刻录机的子通道布局。结果按惯例记入 `docs/VALIDATION.md`"本地验证"（2026-11-05 条）。
- **实盘**：基于 v1.3.6 的同一修复已在 HP BD-RE BU20N 上完成 CD-R 流式刻录，不再出现 `0xC0AA0301`（用户实测，见 VALIDATION.md 2026-11-03 记录）。rebase 后的构建未另行实盘刻录。CD 数据盘 DAO 与音轨共用同一选择逻辑，由上述自动化测试覆盖。
- 未改动 GUI 和编码链（延迟交织、EFM、ECC），selftest 覆盖项不变，因此不需要更新界面截图。

## 风险与说明

- 同时报告 2 和 3 的刻录机会从 Cooked R-W 切换到 Raw P-W。两者镜像字节相同，cdrecord 也推荐 raw96r。如果遇到 Raw P-W 有固件问题的刻录机，刻录日志会显示所用格式，便于定位。
- 如果将来写入 CD-Text、CD+G 等 R-W 内容，两种格式的镜像将不再相同，需要重新评估。
- 相关：#25 中也有用户报告 CD 流式刻录返回 `0xC0AA0301`。

---

## Summary

CD streaming burns (audio and data-disc DAO) always used IMAPI's cooked R-W subchannel layout (`IMAPI_FORMAT2_RAW_CD_SUBCODE_IS_COOKED`). Some recorders list that layout in `SupportedSectorTypes` but cannot write it, so the burn fails immediately at the lead-in with `0xC0AA0301`. This PR uses raw P-W (`IMAPI_FORMAT2_RAW_CD_SUBCODE_IS_RAW`) when the recorder supports it and keeps cooked R-W otherwise.

## Problem and root cause

- **Symptom**: an HP BD-RE BU20N (HL-DT-ST, firmware 0403, USB) with a Lenovo Thinkplus CD-R 80min fails right after "writing CD lead-in" in v1.3.6 with `0xC0AA0301`. Capacity is sufficient (ATIP 79:59:70 = 359,845 sectors; the burn used 359,840), and the disc stays blank after the failure.
- **Drive report**: the drive reports `SupportedSectorTypes = [1, 2, 3]` for this disc, so the existing support check passes.
- **Reproduction**: a standalone SCSI tool ran a Test Write simulation (nothing burned in the program area). With MMC write type RAW and data block type 2 (cooked/packed R-W), the drive accepts MODE SELECT but rejects the first `WRITE(10)` at the lead-in start with sense `5/64/00` (ILLEGAL MODE FOR THIS TRACK). The result is the same at 4x and 16x, so speed is not a factor. IMAPI reports this as `E_IMAPI_UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE_FROM_DEVICE` (`0xC0AA0301`).
- **Contrast**: on the same disc, RAW with data block type 3 (raw P-W) accepted the first 3,000 consecutive lead-in sectors at 4x, and SAO (cue sheet) writing proceeded normally.
- **Why switching is safe**: in memory, `MsftRawCDImageCreator` produces byte-identical images for `ResultingImageType` 2 and 3, with R-W empty. Raw P-W therefore leaves the disc content unchanged and only changes the subchannel layout announced to the recorder. The cdrecord documentation also recommends raw96r over raw96p.

## Changes

**`src/DiscImageStudio.Burning`**

- `WindowsImapiBurner.BurnCdDao` reads `SupportedSectorTypes` once and picks the type through the new `ResolveCdDaoSectorType`.
  - It prefers raw P-W (3) and falls back to cooked R-W (2).
  - If neither is offered (e.g. PQ only), it fails before writing and releases the prepared media.
  - The chosen type is used for both `SetRequestedSectorType` and image construction.
- A new optional `reportDiagnostic` callback adds a burn-log line such as `CD DAO 子通道格式：Raw P-W（IMAPI 类型 3）；光驱报告支持：1, 2, 3。`
- `ICdRawImageSession.CreateImage(content, sectorType)` takes the type explicitly. `DynamicCdRawImageSession` sets `ResultingImageType` before `AddTrack`/`CreateResultImage` and rejects anything other than the 2448-byte layouts (PQ_ONLY uses 2368-byte sectors).
- `CdDataRawImageSession` (CD data-disc DAO) passes the same type to its template image. Its subchannel patching only touches P/Q and preserves R-W, so it works with either 96-byte layout.
- A new `CdRawSectorType` class replaces the two separate hard-coded `2` constants.

**`tests/DiscImageStudio.ArchitectureTests`**

- The fake recorder takes configurable reported sector types and records both the requested type and the image type.
- New coverage:
  - raw P-W preference;
  - cooked R-W fallback;
  - PQ-only or empty-list rejection, with no write and with media release;
  - the supported list is read only once;
  - the log line text;
  - type propagation on the data-disc DAO path.
- Native in-memory IMAPI tests:
  - complete cooked and raw images are byte-identical, with R-W empty;
  - the requested type actually reaches `IRawCDImageCreator`;
  - the byte-order and data-disc image tests now run for both layouts.

**Docs**

- `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased (Chinese and English), `docs/VALIDATION.md`, `docs/CD_AUDIO_COMPATIBILITY.md`.

## Behavior changes

- Recorders that report raw P-W now use it. Recorders that report only cooked R-W behave as before.
- Data written to the disc is unchanged (the images are byte-identical).
- If neither layout is supported, the error message lists the types the drive reported.

## Verification

All results below were re-run on the commit rebased onto current main (`507cac7`), with .NET SDK 10.0.403 on Windows, Release:

- `dotnet build DiscImageStudio.slnx --configuration Release`: 0 warnings, 0 errors.
- `dotnet run --project src/DvdImageSolver --configuration Release -- selftest`: passed.
- `dotnet run --project tests/DiscImageStudio.ArchitectureTests --configuration Release`: all checks passed, including main's new `cd-burn-phase-diagnostics` and this PR's raw P-W checks (`cd-data-dao-workflow`, `cd-data-raw-image`, `cd-raw-image-byte-order`).
- A self-contained single-file win-x64 publish passed the smoke checks from `packaging/Build-Release.ps1`: `burn-build-info` (`Raw CD DAO writer present: True`), the app `selftest`, two-sector RAW (4704 bytes) / WAV (4748 bytes) / CUE, `--cue false`, and `ui-snapshot`.
- **VALIDATION.md regression items**: this PR changes streaming burns. I re-checked the "CD image export and audio direct burn", "CD Mode 1 file disc and streaming burn", "streaming burn display" and "CD data DAO" items. title: feat: add auto-calibration tool
body:
## Features

- Renders a self-locating calibration target: ring barcode plus multi-layer angle code (`disc-calib pattern`)
- Solves the inner and outer radii automatically from phone photos (`disc-calib code --photo ...`)
- Solves several photos of one disc jointly, with a separate rotation per photo
- Reads JPEG and HEIC
- Locates the outer edge, corrects perspective, and fits the center error
- Checks the solution's direction against a mirrored target
- Flags and excludes unreadable photos; falls back to the frequency method when none are readable
- Reports a quality grade (good / fair / poor) and writes `code.fit.json`
- Optionally fits cubic track pitch (`--cubic`)

I would like to collect as many of your test photos as possible to improve the auto-calibration algorithm.

nodes.body:
## Shooting conditions and accuracy on real discs

Measured on 12 photos of two burned discs, taken with an iPhone 17 main camera (26 mm equivalent, f/1.6). Tilt is estimated from the outer-edge ellipse as `acos(b/a)`. This is a small sample, so treat these as guidance rather than a spec.

### Shooting angle

| Tilt | Photos | Angle code readable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Under 15° | 8 | 4 |
| 15° to 20° | 3 | 0 |
| About 31° | 1 | 1, but the least accurate result |

- **Tilt:** keep it under about 15°. The two best photos were at 7° and 14°.
- **Low tilt is not enough:** four photos between 5.6° and 12.8° still could not be read, so tilt is not the main factor. Visibility of the pattern under the lighting is the likely cause, but I did not measure it.
- **Resolution:** readable photos had 27 to 44 px/mm, a disc diameter of about 3200 to 5300 px. The one photo at 10 px/mm could not be read.
- **Best photos:** both showed all six rings across at least 175°, with a ring residual of 0.07 mm against 0.15 to 0.28 mm for the other readable photos.
- **Take several photos:** only 5 of the 12 were readable.

### Accuracy

Calibration takes only 1 to 2 discs. With DVD-RW, one disc is enough, since it can be erased and burned again.

The solved radii converge to about ±0.0001 mm, but the pattern can still twist by 10° to 20°, with a tangential offset of up to about 8 to 13 mm. The pattern is very sensitive: a 0.0001 mm radius error alone gives about 19° of twist.

| Comparison | Inner / outer difference (mm) | Twist | Max tangential offset |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Nominal 24/58 vs solved, uncalibrated | 0.084 / 0.144 | 123 turns | n/a |
| Disc 3 generation parameters (from disc 2's solve) vs disc 3's solve | 0.00011 / 0.00015 | 18° | 12.6 mm |
| Disc 2's solve vs disc 3's solve | 0.00008 / 0.00010 | 11° | 7.8 mm |
| Same disc: best photo alone vs joint solve | 0.0000003 / 0.000002 | 0.4° | 0.24 mm |
| Same disc: 31° photo alone vs best photo alone | 0.00064 / 0.00039 | 76° | 25.5 mm |

Twist is the phase difference across the radius, and the offset is measured after removing the overall rotation.

### Limits

- All numbers come from real burned discs. Disc 3 was generated from disc 2's solve and came back within about 0.05 turns, down from 123 turns uncalibrated, so the calibration works in a closed loop. The image burned with the calibrated parameters came out fine.
- There is no independent measurement of the true radii, so the remaining 10° to 20° could be measurement error or real differences between discs or burns.
- The fit residual on disc 3 is 0.22 mm (0.32°). That only shows how well the curve fits the photo edges.
- `good` can be optimistic. It counts readable photos but does not check that they agree: disc 3 is rated `good`, yet its result comes almost entirely from one photo, and the other readable photo disagrees by 76° when solved alone.
- Cubic pitch was not fitted in these runs.
- The next check is to burn a disc from disc 3's solve and solve each photo separately.

Add Optional PGP Signatures to Release Assets
body:
## Changes

This PR adds optional PGP file signing to the CI release workflow. Once the corresponding PGP private key is configured, CI will generate digital signatures for release assets during the release process.

This feature is **optional**. If the required key is not configured, CI will automatically skip the signing steps without affecting the existing release workflow.

## Tools and Configuration

- **Tool:** [Sequoia PGP](https://sequoia-pgp.org/)
- **Configuration:** Set `RELEASE_SIGN_KEY` in GitHub Actions Secrets. Its value should be the PGP private key used for signing.
- **Compatibility:** The signing functionality is implemented using Sequoia PGP and supports signing with OpenPGP private keys generated by GnuPG.

## Post-Quantum Signing Keys

Sequoia PGP supports **standardized** post-quantum signature algorithms such as ML-DSA when using the OpenSSL cryptographic backend and an underlying OpenSSL version that supports the corresponding algorithms. OpenSSL **3.5.0** or later is recommended.

For users who wish to experiment with post-quantum signatures, the following command generates a key using the hybrid ML-DSA-65 and Ed25519 signing algorithm:

```bash
sq key generate --own-key \
  --signing-algorithm mldsa65-ed25519 \
  --profile rfc9580 \
  --name <your name> \
  --email <your email> \
  --output <path to save the private key> \
  --rev-cert <path to save the revocation certificate>
```

**Compatibility Notes:**

As of November 10, 2026, GnuPG does not yet support the post-quantum signature algorithms mentioned above. In addition, there are still some interoperability limitations between GnuPG and [RFC 9580](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9580.html). Therefore, if interoperability with GnuPG is required, traditional signature algorithms are currently recommended.

Please note that the post-quantum support of keys generated using the command above currently applies only to digital signatures. Other operations, such as public-key encryption, still rely on traditional cryptographic algorithms. Therefore, the entire cryptographic process should not be considered post-quantum secure.

If needed, you can also add the `--encryption-algorithm mlkem768-x25519` parameter when generating a key to enable post-quantum public-key encryption. However, this algorithm may increase the size of the private key file, potentially causing it to exceed the GitHub Actions Secrets size limit and making it impossible to store directly.

In theory, Sequoia PGP is compatible with private and public keys from other PGP implementations that support [RFC 4880](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4880.html), [RFC 9580](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9580.html), and [RFC 9980](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9980.html).

As of November 10, 2026, I have not yet tested private and public keys generated by other PGP implementations. However, I have verified that traditional, pre-quantum private and public keys generated by GnuPG can be processed by Sequoia PGP.

**Why Sequoia PGP Instead of GnuPG?**

GnuPG does not yet support post-quantum signatures. As of [GnuPG 2.5.24](https://lists.gnupg.org/pipermail/gnupg-announce/2026q3/000516.html), it only supports using [Kyber](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/203/final) for public-key encryption to protect against *Harvest Now, Decrypt Later* attacks.

Furthermore, GnuPG does not interoperate with [RFC 9580](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9580.html) and [RFC 9980](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9980.html), or has limited interoperability with them.

To maintain compatibility with a wider range of PGP software currently available, while also ensuring that the software used for signing has memory safety to the greatest extent possible, this PR uses Sequoia PGP, which is written in Rust.

*To my knowledge, Red Hat has already adopted Sequoia PGP for [signing RPM packages](https://docs.redhat.com/zh-cn/documentation/red_hat_enterprise_linux/10/html/packaging_and_distributing_software/configuring-rpm-for-sequoia). This is also one of the reasons I chose this signing tool for this PR.*

### CI Environment and Build Configuration Changes

To support post-quantum signatures, this PR also makes adjustments to the CI environment and the way Sequoia PGP is built.

The `sq` package provided by the Ubuntu repositories uses the Nettle cryptographic backend by default, whereas Sequoia PGP's current support for post-quantum algorithms depends on the OpenSSL backend.

Therefore, instead of using the `sq` package provided by the distribution, CI builds Sequoia SQ from source using Cargo when signing is required, explicitly enabling the `crypto-openssl` feature.

To avoid repeated builds, **`actions/cache` is used to cache the Sequoia SQ binary** in CI. You can delete the corresponding cache under Actions -> Management -> Cache to trigger a fresh Sequoia SQ build during the next release.

Additionally, the GitHub Actions runner environment has been changed from `ubuntu-latest` to `ubuntu-26.04` to use OpenSSL 3.5.x provided by Ubuntu 26.04, which is required for support of post-quantum algorithms such as ML-DSA.

All of the above build and signing steps are optional and are executed only when `RELEASE_SIGN_KEY` is configured. If no key is configured, Sequoia SQ will not be built, and the existing release workflow will remain unaffected.

## Notes

The documentation and some of the code in this PR were prepared with assistance from ChatGPT and DeepSeek, and tested using GitHub Actions in my forked repository.

**To avoid code conflicts, PGP signature verification for release assets has not yet been added to the in-app auto-update functionality.** If signature verification is to be integrated into the auto-update functionality, possible approaches include using JNI to call libraries provided by Sequoia PGP to verify signatures, or bundling `sq` into the distributed binary and invoking it through the command line to verify signatures.

To further improve release security, you may also consider enabling **Immutable Releases**.

For a demonstration of the actual results of this PR, you can check out the test release I created in my forked repository:

https://github.com/jinnang233/DiscImageStudio/releases/tag/v1.5.0

Thank you for taking the time to review this PR. I welcome any feedback or suggestions.

title: Place DVD hybrid files in blank areas of the picture
body:
## Summary

DVD hybrid discs can now store the data folder inside the blank parts of the picture instead of only the inner or outer ring. A new **Place files in blank area** option on the Design page enables it.

- **Blank-area detection.** A sector is blank when its whole spiral footprint lies on transparent pixels, near-white pixels (luminance >= 250), or the picture's dominant flat background colour (per-channel tolerance 6, used only when that colour covers at least 15% of the printable ring). Files are split into sector-granular ISO 9660/Joliet extents and packed into the outermost blank runs first.
- **ECC-aware mixed blocks.** File sectors are fixed before each 16-sector ECC block is solved. Blocks that mix file and picture sectors are re-encoded through the full DVD ECC/EFMPlus encoder with the file sectors locked; nothing is overwritten after ECC is computed. Blocks without files keep the parallel fast dispersion path.
- **Exact physical boundary chain.** The EFMPlus state/DSV/NRZI boundary is carried across every block (fast, mixed and file-only), so the whole disc matches a sequential encode. On by default for blank-area placement; `--exact-physical-chain false` restores the faster unchained output.
- **UI.** Capacity estimate (blank space, needed space, segment count) runs in the background with cancellation. The preview overlay shows the file segments. The sidecar records the file segments and final modulation boundary.
- **CLI.** `--file-position transparent`, `--white-is-blank`, `--background-is-blank`, `--exact-physical-chain`.
- **Build fix.** `DiscImageStudio.Dvd` now references `DiscImageStudio.Iso` for both target frameworks; the portable `net10.0` target failed without it after the v1.3.6 CLI split.
- New UI strings are translated into all seven languages.
- New tool `tools/DvdTransparencyProbe` (read-only analysis of how many ECC blocks a picture leaves blank).

## Validation

- `dotnet build DiscImageStudio.slnx --configuration Release`: 0 warnings, 0 errors.
- `dotnet run --project src/DvdImageSolver --configuration Release -- selftest`: all checks passed. New checks cover multi-extent mixed blocks, locked file bytes, PI/PO remainders of every mixed block, the replayed boundary chain against a sequential encode, and cancellation.
- `dotnet run --project tests/DiscImageStudio.ArchitectureTests --configuration Release`: all checks passed. New cases cover transparent placement, mixed ECC blocks at non-aligned boundaries, streaming parity, Joliet byte equality, capacity estimates, and a pale noisy opaque background (0 blank sectors with detection off, files fit and read back byte-identical with it on).
- Real composite picture (2048x2048, no transparency, pale lavender background), full 2,297,888-sector DVD+R geometry, 12.5 MB data folder:
  - Previous rule: "The picture leaves only 0 blank sectors".
  - New rule: files placed in 1,473 segments; extents concatenated from the ISO are byte-identical to the source file.
  - Fast output ~33 s; exact boundary chain ~274 s.
- Windows single-file EXE built with `packaging/Build-Release.ps1`; all published-package smoke checks passed.

## Notes

- Sectors holding file data show the file's texture rather than the background colour, so a pale background gains small scattered patches. The picture itself is never overwritten.
- `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased is updated in both languages.

计划保留分散存放功能，同时保留内圈／外圈作为明确的兜底位置。设计页只显示稳定的兜底风险遮罩，实际分散布局在预览阶段计算。

建议调整为：

- 先建立能容纳全部文件的合法内圈／外圈布局，再尝试将数据迁往允许占用的空白扇区；无法迁移的部分保留在兜底范围。
- 根据碎片数量上限计算目录元数据及对齐预算，替换固定增加 32 个扇区的估算，并将同一预算提供给 #161。超出预算时减少碎片或完整回退。
- 将设计页的空白扫描移到预览阶段，明确透明、白色和背景色各自是否允许被文件占用。
- 预览、导出和刻录共用同一版本的源图、文件清单和布局。输入变化后使旧布局失效，避免生成时静默重新分配。

此前检查发现的混合 ECC 块中绘图数据丢失、文件系统前缀后的调制状态衔接问题，也仍需修复。直接流式刻录还需要验证持续生成速率、最长输出间隔和取消响应；仅调整布局策略不能解决这些问题。

---

The plan is to retain dispersed placement while keeping an explicit **inner/outer-ring fallback**. The Design page would show a stable fallback guide, while actual dispersed placement would be calculated during preview.

The proposed changes are:

- Start with a valid inner/outer-ring layout that can hold all files, then relocate data into eligible blank sectors. Data that cannot be relocated stays within the fallback allocation.
- Calculate metadata and alignment reservations from a bounded fragment count instead of the fixed additional 32-sector estimate. Share this budget with #161. Reduce fragmentation or fall back completely if the budget is exceeded.
- Move blank-area scanning out of the Design page and into the preview stage. Clearly define whether transparent pixels, white pixels and background colours are eligible for file placement.
- Use the same source-image revision, file manifest and layout for preview, export and burning. Changes to those inputs should invalidate the layout rather than silently produce a different allocation during generation.

The previously identified loss of artwork data in mixed ECC blocks and modulation-state continuity after the filesystem prefix also need to be fixed. Direct streaming burns additionally need validation of sustained throughput, maximum output gaps and cancellation responsiveness; changing the placement strategy alone does not resolve those issues.

title: Keep app cache next to the EXE and stop full single-file extraction
body:
## Motivation

The app wrote to the system temp folder in two ways:

- The default cache (`%TEMP%\DiscImageStudio`) for design composites, previews and thumbnails.
- The single-file EXE extracted its full bundle (about 475 MB per version) into `%TEMP%\.net`, because the release script enabled `IncludeAllContentForSelfExtract`.

## Changes

- **Default cache location:** `DiscImageStudio-cache` next to the executable. If that folder cannot be written (for example under Program Files), the cache falls back to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DiscImageStudio\cache`. The system temp folder is no longer used. A custom cache folder from Settings still works as before.
- **Release packaging:** removed `IncludeAllContentForSelfExtract` from `packaging/Build-Release.ps1`. Managed assemblies now load directly from the bundle. Only the five WPF native DLLs (about 7.9 MB) are still extracted, since native libraries must be loaded from disk and .NET has no build-time option to change the extraction folder. No code depends on `Assembly.Location`.
- The settings snapshot renderer no longer writes its throwaway settings file to `%TEMP%`.
- Updated the settings hint and the cache-fallback toast in all seven languages to describe the new behaviour.
- CHANGELOG Unreleased entries in Chinese and English.

## Validation

- `dotnet build DiscImageStudio.slnx --configuration Release`: 0 warnings, 0 errors
- `dotnet run --project src/DvdImageSolver --configuration Release -- selftest`: all checks passed
- `dotnet run --project tests/DiscImageStudio.ArchitectureTests --configuration Release`: all checks passed
- `packaging/Build-Release.ps1`: all published-package smoke checks passed; `%TEMP%\.net` extraction dropped from about 475 MB to 7.9 MB; cache files were written beside the EXE.
- `git diff --check`: clean

title: Experimental opt-in DVD "write-safe" mode for drives that abort on long single-tone areas
body:
# Experimental opt-in DVD "write-safe" mode for drives that abort on long single-tone areas

Related: #148 (similar 0xC0AA0301 failures, reported there for CD; this is the DVD-R variant)

## Summary

This PR adds an **opt-in, off-by-default** experimental mode that makes DVD image
data slightly less "pure" so that some drive/media combinations stop aborting mid-burn
with `0xC0AA0301` ("drive returned error information that could not be recovered from").

With the environment variable unset, generated output is byte-for-byte identical to
v1.4.2 (all self-tests pass unchanged). We are proposing it as a possible starting
point for users who hit the same problem, not as a finished feature — happy to
reshape it (UI toggle, preset option, different bytes) or drop it if you see a better fix.

## The problem we saw

Setup: slim drive `HL-DT-ST DVDRAM GUA0N`, DVD-R (one 50-disc batch), IMAPI2,
supported write speeds 8× and 4× only.

| Build / setting | Speed | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1.4.1 | 4× | failed at LBA 332,671 (`0xC0AA0301`) |
| 1.4.2 | 8× | failed at LBA 172,639 (`0xC0AA0301`) |
| 1.4.2 + write-safe level 1 | 8× | completed (twice); one run slowed down heavily around 305–365 MiB and recovered |
| 1.4.2 + write-safe level 1 | 4× | `0xC0AA020D` timeout at LBA 194,207 |
| 1.4.2 + write-safe level 3 (zone) | 8× | completed, no slowdown observed in the risky band |
| Ordinary game ISO via ImgBurn | 8× | completed (drive and media are fine with normal data) |

All image failures cluster at a disc radius of roughly **27.6–28.5 mm**, which in our
designs is exactly where a large dark area starts/thickens. Normal data burns fine on
the same drive and media.

## Hypothesis

`0xA5` (black) and `0x92` (white) are the only Q bytes with exactly 5 / 2 transitions
in every EFMPlus state. A long single-tone area therefore records as an almost
single-frequency signal (black ≈ 80% 3T; white = 100% 8T). Our guess is that runtime
OPC / write strategy on some slim drives loses lock on such long stretches and the drive
gives up. Breaking up the spectrum a little fixed it for us. We could not confirm the
drive-side mechanism; this is empirical.

## What the change does

`DISCIMAGESTUDIO_DVD_WRITE_SAFE`:

| Value | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| unset / `0` | unchanged (default) |
| `1` / `true` | every 4th tone byte replaced by a near-tone byte (white: `90 94 98 9D`, black: `3B 3C 63 64`). ~17% contrast cost. |
| `2` / `strong` | as 1, but black uses every 2nd byte from `58 5D B0 B7` (3T share 80% → ~38%). Dark areas look visibly lighter. |
| `3` / `zone` | strong black only inside an LBA zone (default 100,000–300,000 ≈ 26.4–30.6 mm on a 24–58 mm disc), level 1 elsewhere. |

`DISCIMAGESTUDIO_DVD_WRITE_SAFE_ZONE=start-end` overrides the zone.

Insert bytes were chosen by simulating an encoder that picks main/substitution code words
and state alternatives by |DSV| while respecting the 3T–11T run-length limit at word
boundaries; simulated max |DSV| stays ≤ 2 for every pattern (a naive rotation of
arbitrary bytes pushed DSV into the tens of thousands, so the choice matters).

Inserts are classified by `TryGetLuminance` as their anchor tone, so readback/preview
treat them as black/white.

Touched code:
- `DvdGrayscalePalette` — insert tables, level/zone parsing, `ApplyWriteSafe(anchor, toneIndex)`.
- `FastDispersionImageWriter` — all three anchor paths (`ScrambledForLuminance`, `_sampleCodeword`, sector fill) go through `ApplyWriteSafe`.
- `DispersionPoolSolver` — same, so the exact solver and the fast writer stay byte-identical.
- `SelfTests` — new checks for insert placement and readback; the existing dispersion payload check now expects `ApplyWriteSafe(...)`.
- `ShellViewModel` — small `[WriteSafe …]` suffix in the title bar while the mode is on (self-contained, easy to drop).

`toneIndex` is the absolute payload byte index (`lba * 2048 + i`), so the pattern is
deterministic and the zone is addressable by LBA.

## Caveats / known trade-offs

- **Lower contrast, always.** Every level trades image contrast for writability.
  Level 1 costs roughly 17%. Level 2 makes dark areas visibly lighter across the whole
  disc; in our burn of a design image the result was very faint.
- **Level 3 leaves a visible lighter ring.** Inside the zone (default ≈ 26.4–30.6 mm)
  dark areas are as light as level 2 while the rest of the disc stays at level 1, so
  dark regions show a faint ring/step at the zone edges. Fine for diagnosis, usually
  not what you want in a finished design.
- **The default zone is tuned to one drive.** 100,000–300,000 LBA matches where *our*
  slim drive failed. Other drive/media pairs may fail elsewhere; the zone must then be
  moved with `DISCIMAGESTUDIO_DVD_WRITE_SAFE_ZONE`, and we have no way to predict it.
- **Calibration interplay is untested.** We did not verify that coarse/boundary
  calibration fits stay valid when targets are burned with the mode on. Lower contrast
  may make boundary edges harder to trace in photos.
- **Not a guaranteed fix.** One drive, one media batch, a handful of burns. Level 1 at
  4× still timed out once (`0xC0AA020D`), and one level 1 burn failed after 7 MiB, which
  we attribute to a disc defect but cannot prove.
- **Hypothesis is unverified.** The OPC / single-frequency explanation fits the data
  but we have no drive-side evidence. The DSV simulation models a plausible encoder,
  not any specific drive firmware.
- **Global env var, not a project setting.** The level is read once at startup and
  applies to every DVD image generated (streamed burns and ISO export) until the app
  restarts.
- **Previews overstate contrast.** `DvdTonePreview` maps tones on the source side and
  never calls `ApplyWriteSafe`, and `IsoReadbackRenderer` classifies inserts as their
  anchor tone via `TryGetLuminance`. Both previews therefore show full black/white even
  though the burned disc will be lighter (especially at levels 2–3, and the level 3
  zone ring is not visible in either preview).
- **Some existing self-tests fail when the mode is on** (see Testing). They assume pure
  `A5`/`92` output.
- **DVD only.** CD and Blu-ray paths are untouched.

## Testing

- `selftest` passes fully at level 0 (default), so existing behaviour is unchanged.
- At levels 1–3 the new write-safe checks and the exact-solver vs. fast-writer
  equality check pass. A few older checks that assert the raw `A5`/`92` bytes
  (e.g. codeword boundary quantization) fail by design, because the mode replaces
  some of those bytes. I left them alone rather than sprinkling level checks
  everywhere; happy to adjust if you prefer.
- Real burns as in the table above (small sample size: one drive, one media batch).

## Second, unrelated observation (not changed in this PR)

Discs from the same batch report different track sizes (2,297,888 vs. 2,298,496
sectors — 38 ECC blocks apart). When a coarse calibration was made on a target generated
with a different sector count, the saved inner/outer radii are kept as-is and only
`DvdTotalSectors` is updated, so the drawing lands slightly off (we needed to correct the
outer radius by ~0.03 mm by hand). Rescaling the fitted radii, or warning when the
sector count differs from the target's, might help. Happy to open a separate issue.

title: Allow overwriting a formatted DVD+RW in DVD streaming burns
body:
A DVD+RW keeps its format after an erase, so IDiscFormat2Data reports IMAPI_FORMAT2_DATA_MEDIA_STATE_OVERWRITE_ONLY (0x1) instead of BLANK and refuses the write with E_IMAPI_DF2DATA_MEDIA_NOT_BLANK unless ForceOverwrite is enabled.

An erase pass through IDiscFormat2Erase is not a substitute: the disc stays in the OVERWRITE_ONLY state after erasing (#203), so ForceOverwrite is still required and a separate erase would only add a second full-disc pass and another failure point.

Add OpticalBurnRequest.OverwriteRewritableMedia (default false) and a DVD-only "allow overwrite" checkbox. BurnData sets ForceOverwrite, validates the overwrite-only media state, and sizes the capacity check against the disc total because the rewrite restarts at LBA 0. Appendable and finalized write-once media remain rejected. Capacity reads report the full data area for an overwrite-only disc, and DVD diagnostics add TotalSectors and Overwrite.

Validation: Release solution build (0 warnings, 0 errors), architecture suite including the new dvd-rewritable-overwrite tests, and DVD engine selftest. Review effort: Balanced

The metadata partition map advertises a 32-block allocation unit, but this assigns the unrounded metadata length to the Metadata File and its mirror. The added BDMV fixture produces 16-block extents, which do not satisfy that allocation unit. Round the metadata allocation up to 32 blocks before assigning file-data positions so the emitted UDF 2.50 layout respects its declared granularity.

Selecting UDF still leaves the design page's occupied-region guide and capacity warnings based on CDFS: `CaptureDataRegionInputs` omits the filesystem, and `DataRegionPlanner.ComputeDvd` constructs default-CDFS options. This can also report a false capacity overflow for a file larger than 4 GiB that fits on a UDF DVD. Carry the selection through `DataRegionInputs` into the planner and schedule a guide refresh when `DvdFileSystem` changes.

The tone preview now depends on DvdFileSystem, but State_PropertyChanged does not include that property among the inputs that call ScheduleTonePreview. Switching only the filesystem therefore leaves the existing preview and file-region overlay using the previous layout until some unrelated parameter changes, while export uses the new layout. Add DvdFileSystem to the preview invalidation list.

The metadata partition map declares a 32-block alignment unit, but placing the mirror data immediately after its EFE can leave the mirror extent unaligned (partition-relative block 57 in the added BDMV fixture). This produces a nonconforming metadata mirror that readers enforcing the alignment constraint may reject. Round the mirror data start up to the next 32-block boundary; `WriteMetadataContent` already pads to that position.

title: Validate Joliet volume labels before ISO generation
body:
修复 #233。

CD／DVD 镜像使用 Joliet 补充卷描述符，其卷标识字段为 32 字节 UCS-2，最多容纳 16 个 UTF-16 字符。此前超长卷标在写入时被静默截断，Windows 资源管理器显示的名称与用户输入不一致。

## 改动

- `Iso9660ImageWriter.Plan` 在文件系统布局前校验卷标：规范化后超过 16 个字符即抛出 `ArgumentException`，不再静默截断；文件／目录标识的截断逻辑保持不变。
- 应用侧新增 `DiscParametersState.ResolveVolumeLabel`，导出、刻录、实时预览和影调预览统一复用；CD／DVD 超长时用本地化文案报错，蓝光 UDF 卷标维持原有宽度。
- 导出页 CD／DVD 卷标输入框限制为 16 个字符，并显示「最多 16 个字符（Joliet 标准）。」提示。

### English

CD/DVD images store the Joliet volume identifier in a 32-byte UCS-2 field, so labels longer than 16 characters were silently truncated and Explorer showed a different name. The writer now rejects over-long labels before layout, the app reports a localized error through a shared resolver used by export, burn, preview and tone preview, and the export page caps the input at 16 characters with a hint. Blu-ray UDF labels are unchanged. Verified with a Release build, the DVD solver selftest and the full architecture suite; no physical burn was performed.

title: 引入应用内更新流程
body:
引入 Windows 便携版的应用内更新流程。

## 改动

- 关于页在 GitHub 按钮左侧新增「检查更新」：从上游正式版 Release 的 `latest.json` 获取版本信息，按当前处理器架构下载便携 EXE，校验字节数与 SHA-256 后替换并重启；替换失败或新版本启动即退出时恢复旧 EXE，应用目录不可写时提示手动下载。
- 新增 `AppUpdateService`、`AppVersion`，更新期间使用命名信号量阻止并发下载／安装；下载、确认与安装流程接入主窗口和设置窗口的现有保存逻辑。
- 发布工作流从已测试的 win-x64／win-arm64 EXE 生成 `latest.json`，加入 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 与 Release 附件；新增 `packaging/New-UpdateManifest.ps1`。
- 同步更新隐私政策、CHANGELOG、`docs/RELEASING.md`、`docs/VALIDATION.md` 与本地化目录；各语种 README 补充 Trendshift 与 Discord 徽章。

### English

Add an in-app update flow for the portable Windows builds. The About page gains a "Check for updates" button that reads the stable release manifest (`latest.json`), downloads the portable EXE matching the current processor architecture, verifies its byte length and SHA-256, then replaces the running executable and restarts. Failed replacements and builds that exit during startup roll back to the previous EXE; a non-writable application folder prompts a manual download. The release workflow now generates `latest.json` from the tested win-x64 and win-arm64 executables and publishes it with the checksums and release assets. Privacy policy, changelog, release docs, localization catalogs and localized READMEs are updated accordingly.

## 测试

- 新增 `UpdateTests`，覆盖清单解析、下载 URL 校验、版本比较、健康标记与回滚等路径。
- 发布清单生成与 Release 附件流程由 `Test-ReleaseTooling.ps1` 覆盖。
- 端到端更新需在正式版公开后，用上一版便携 EXE 实际执行；未做物理校验之外的签名验证，清单与 EXE 均未签名。

title: 引入光驱信息读取功能
body:
在侧边栏的项目模式中加入只读的光驱与介质信息卡片。

## 改动

- 新增 `DriveInfoCard`（含 `OpticalDiscVisual` 光碟图形与 `CopyableText` 可复制文本）：显示光驱厂商/型号/固件、盘符，以及介质的规格（profile）、状态（空白/未完成/已完成）、MID 与厂商、CD-R/RW 的 ATIP、总/可写/剩余扇区、下一可写地址和读写速度；详情可展开，多光驱时可选目标光驱。卡片只在项目模式且检测到刻录机时显示。
- 新增 `ImapiOpticalDriveProbe`（实现 `IOpticalDriveProbe`）：设备枚举走 IMAPI2，介质信息通过 MMC 只读命令读取（GET CONFIGURATION、READ DISC INFORMATION、READ DISC/TRACK/ATIP STRUCTURE、GET PERFORMANCE），覆盖 CD/DVD/BD。
- 新增 `OpticalDriveViewModel`：每 5 秒轮询一次，刻录占用刻录机时暂停，窗口关闭时取消探测；默认跟随刻录用机，也允许手动切换。
- 抽取 `ImapiCom.RunOnStaThread` 作为共用的 STA 线程封装，`WindowsImapiBurner` 改为复用，并复用 `BluRayMmcCommands` 的 MMC 传输。
- **侧边栏原「收起/展开」按钮的位置由光驱卡片占用，手动折叠逻辑与 `SideNavItem.IsCollapsed` 一并移除。**
- 快照渲染新增 `SnapshotOpticalDriveProbe` 夹具（`none/empty/cd/dvd/bd/error`），截图不会访问本机光驱。
- 新增 `DriveInfo.json` 本地化目录（zh-CN/en/zh-TW/ja/tr/es/cs）。

### English

Add a read-only optical drive and media card to the sidebar in project mode. The card shows the recorder vendor/model/firmware and volume paths plus the inserted medium's profile, state (blank/incomplete/complete), MID and manufacturer, CD-R/RW ATIP, total/usable/free sectors, next writable address and read/write speeds, with expandable details and a selector when multiple recorders are present. A new `ImapiOpticalDriveProbe` enumerates devices through IMAPI2 and reads media data with MMC read-only commands only (GET CONFIGURATION, READ DISC INFORMATION, READ DISC/TRACK/ATIP STRUCTURE, GET PERFORMANCE) across CD, DVD and Blu-ray; no command in this path prepares, formats or closes a medium. The view model polls every five seconds, pauses while a burn owns the recorder and cancels when the window closes, following the burn target unless the user picks another drive. The shared `ImapiCom.RunOnStaThread` helper and `BluRayMmcCommands` transport are reused by the existing burner. The manual sidebar collapse toggle is replaced by the card and its `SideNavItem.IsCollapsed` state is removed. UI snapshots use a `SnapshotOpticalDriveProbe` fixture so captures never touch the workstation's recorder, and the catalog adds `DriveInfo.json` for all seven locales.

title: Add outer-ring music for CDs: picture in the pre-gap of track 1 (on top of #287)
body:
> Draft。这是拆分后的外圈部分，叠在内圈的 #287 之上：#287 合并之前，这里的改动列表会同时包含两部分；合并之后只剩外圈。原理与两种布局的取舍见讨论帖 #286：https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/286 。
>
> Draft. This is the outer-ring part after the split, stacked on #287 (the inner-ring part). Until #287 is merged the diff here shows both; afterwards only the outer part remains. The principle and the trade-offs of the two layouts are in discussion #286.

## 摘要

给「音乐 + 图片」CD 增加第二种音乐位置：音乐在外圈。整张盘是一个普通的音频区段，图片写在第 1 轨的预间隙（索引 0）里，从 LBA 0 开始；音乐紧随其后，一直排到盘片可用容量的末尾。目录把第 1 轨的起点记在图片之后，所以 CD 机直接从音乐开始播放。

音乐卡片里新增「音乐位置」开关（内圈／外圈），默认外圈。内圈就是 #287 的 CD-Extra。

## 只属于本 PR 的改动

**`src/DiscImageStudio.Cd`**

- `CdExtraLayout.PlanOuterMusic`：图片占 LBA 0 起的预间隙，预间隙的最后 150 扇区（2 秒）是数字静音，之后是首尾相接的音乐。
- `CdImageGenerator`：导出一个 WAV（图片、静音段、音乐）和带 `INDEX 00` 的 CUE。图片部分与「整盘图片」的音轨在相同地址上逐字节一致，音乐样本原样跟随。
- `cd-generate`、`cd-preview-warp` 新增 `--music-position outer|inner`，默认 `outer`。

**`src/DiscImageStudio.Burning`**

- `OpticalBurnRequest` 新增可选的 `CdAudioLayout`（预间隙扇区数与各轨扇区数）。有它时，`DynamicCdRawImageSession` 对 IMAPI 原始 CD 镜像生成器调用 `AddSpecialPregap` 和逐轨 `AddTrack`，其余就是现有的 CD DAO 刻录。各段由 `SequentialSliceSource` 从同一条只进流按顺序切出。没有它时行为不变。

**`src/DiscImageStudio.Core`、`src/DiscImageStudio.App`**

- 工程的 `cdExtra` 字段新增 `musicAtOuterRing`（缺省为内圈）。
- 音乐卡片的位置开关；占比条、画布圆环、影调和预览随位置变化；导出页外圈输出 WAV + CUE；刻录页外圈走 CD DAO。外圈音乐是音频盘，不能同时附带随盘文件，界面会提示。

**测试与文档**

- 新增 `cd-outer-music` 回归：用真实的 `MsftRawCDImageCreator` 在内存中构造完整镜像，逐扇区检查内容地址、Q 通道的轨号与索引、目录；另外检查导出的 WAV／CUE、命令行，以及刻录请求产生的数据流与导出的 WAV 逐字节一致。
- 更新 `CHANGELOG.md`、七个 README、`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`、`docs/CD_AUDIO_COMPATIBILITY.md`、`docs/VALIDATION.md`。

## 为什么默认外圈，以及它的代价

- 是标准的单区段音频 CD，沿用已经实盘验证过的 CD DAO 写入方式，不需要新的刻录命令。
- 图片从 LBA 0 开始，所有地址在写入前就确定，不依赖光驱报告的地址。
- 没有 11,400 扇区的区段间隔，曲目之间也没有强制的 2 秒间隔。
- 代价：图片以音频采样的形式存在于第 1 首之前，在第 1 首开头继续倒退、或者用能读预间隙的抓轨软件，会读到它，听到的是噪声；预间隙可能长达几十分钟，老 CD 机的表现需要实测；不能附带随盘文件；外部刻录必须整盘一次写入（DAO）并使用 CUE。

## 验证

本地验证都在 Windows 上完成；我没有 macOS 和 Linux 的本地环境，这两个平台只有 CI 的结果。

- `dotnet build DiscImageStudio.slnx --configuration Release`：0 警告，0 错误。
- `dotnet run --project src/DvdImageSolver --configuration Release -- selftest`：通过。
- `dotnet run --project tests/DiscImageStudio.ArchitectureTests --configuration Release`：`architecture-selftest: all checks passed`。
- GUI：示例工程在两种音乐位置下的设计、导出、刻录页和影调小预览离屏截图并人工检查。
- GitHub Actions：以本 PR 的 `build` 检查为准。

### 实盘

程序内刻录（CD DAO），刻录机 HP BD-RE BU20N（USB）：

- 第一张盘（两首音乐）播放时，第 1 首 0:00 处有一声咔响。把盘读回来看，图片数据比第 1 轨的起点多出去 131 个采样（约 3 毫秒）才结束：刻出来的盘上，音频数据和索引并不精确到采样对齐。
- 修正：预间隙的最后 150 扇区（2 秒）改为数字静音，图片在它之前截止。
- 修正后重新刻了一张，在 Windows 上用 PotPlayer 播放正常，第 1 首开头没有杂音。
- 之后在 CD 机 Syitern R300 上播放也正常，没有任何杂音。
- 尚未记录：曲目数与时间显示、在第 1 首开头倒退时的表现、图片位置与方向；也还没有在其他型号的 CD 机上试过。

## 风险与说明

- 程序内刻录标记为实验性。
- 外圈的兼容性目前只有一台 CD 机（Syitern R300）的结果。很长的预间隙在其他机器、尤其是老式 CD 机上的表现，仍是本 PR 最大的未知数。
- 译文：新增界面文字只提供 zh-CN 与 en；其余语言的 README 条目由我翻译，欢迎母语者修订。

---

## Summary

Add a second music position for "Music + picture" CDs: music on the outer rings. The disc is one ordinary audio session. The picture is the index 0 pre-gap of track 1 from LBA 0, and the music follows it up to the usable capacity. The table of contents starts track 1 behind the picture, so players begin with the music.

The music card gains a "Music position" switch (inner or outer), outer by default. Inner is the CD-Extra layout of #287.

## Changes that belong to this PR

- **Cd**: `CdExtraLayout.PlanOuterMusic` puts the picture in the pre-gap from LBA 0, ends the pre-gap with 150 sectors (2 s) of digital silence, and lets the gapless music follow. `CdImageGenerator` exports one WAV (picture, silence, music) and a CUE sheet with `INDEX 00`; the picture part is byte-identical to the whole-disc audio drawing at the same addresses. `cd-generate` and `cd-preview-warp` gain `--music-position outer|inner`, default `outer`.
- **Burning**: `OpticalBurnRequest` gains an optional `CdAudioLayout` (pre-gap sectors and per-track sectors). With it, `DynamicCdRawImageSession` calls `AddSpecialPregap` and one `AddTrack` per track on the IMAPI raw CD image creator; everything else is the existing CD DAO burn. The parts are cut in order from the one forward-only content stream by `SequentialSliceSource`. Without it nothing changes.
- **Core and App**: the `cdExtra` project block gains `musicAtOuterRing` (missing means inner). The position switch; the share bar, canvas ring, tone and live previews follow it; the export page writes WAV + CUE and the burn page uses CD DAO for the outer position. Outer music makes an audio disc, so disc files cannot be combined with it and the UI says so.
- **Tests and documentation**: a new `cd-outer-music` suite builds a complete image with the real `MsftRawCDImageCreator` in memory and checks content addresses, Q-channel track and index numbers and the table of contents sector by sector; it also checks the exported WAV/CUE, the command line, and that the burn request produces exactly the bytes the export writes. Changelog, READMEs and docs are updated.

## Why outer is the default, and what it costs

- It is a standard single-session audio CD written through the CD DAO path that has already been verified on hardware.
- The picture starts at LBA 0, so every address is fixed before writing.
- There is no 11,400-sector session gap and no forced 2-second gap between tracks.
- Costs: the picture exists as audio samples in front of track 1, so rewinding past the start of track 1, or ripping software that reads pre-gaps, reaches it as noise. The pre-gap can be tens of minutes long, which old players may not like. Disc files are not possible. External burning must be Disc-at-Once with the CUE sheet.

## Validation

Everything local was done on Windows. I have no macOS or Linux machine, so those platforms are covered by CI only.

- Release solution build: 0 warnings, 0 errors. DVD `selftest`: passed. Full architecture suite: `architecture-selftest: all checks passed`.
- GUI: design, export and burn pages and the tone preview of a sample project captured off-screen for both music positions and inspected.
- GitHub Actions: see the `build` check of this PR.

### Physical disc

Burned in the app through the CD DAO path on an HP BD-RE BU20N (USB):

- The first disc (two tracks) clicked at 0:00 of track 1. Read back, the picture data ended 131 samples (about 3 ms) behind the start of track 1: audio and index are not aligned to the sample on a burned disc.
- Fix: the last 150 sectors (2 s) of the pre-gap are digital silence and the picture ends in front of them.
- A disc burned with the fix plays normally in PotPlayer on Windows, without noise at the start of track 1.
- It then also played normally on a Syitern R300 CD player, without any noise.
- Not recorded yet: track count and time display, behaviour when rewinding at the start of track 1, picture position and orientation. No other player model has been tried.

## Risks and notes

- In-app burning is marked experimental.
- Compatibility of the outer layout has been checked on one CD player only (Syitern R300). How a very long pre-gap behaves on other players, old ones in particular, is still the biggest unknown of this PR.
- New UI strings are provided in zh-CN and en only; I translated the README entries for the other languages, and corrections from native speakers are welcome.

body:
> Draft。从 #284 拆出的内圈部分（CD-Extra）；外圈部分留在 #284，叠在本 PR 之上。原理与两种布局的取舍见讨论帖 #286：https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/286 。
>
> Draft. This is the inner-ring part (CD-Extra) split out of #284; the outer-ring part stays in #284 and is stacked on this PR. The principle and the trade-offs of the two layouts are in discussion #286.

## 摘要

新增 CD-Extra（音乐 + 图片）：音乐作为 CD-DA 音轨写在内圈的第 1 区段，图片作为第 2 区段的一条 Mode 1 数据轨写在外圈。音频 CD 机只读第 1 区段，所以能正常放歌，也不会把图片当成曲目播放。

设计页可以添加 WAV 音乐，并按面积显示音乐区、区段间隔和图片区各占多少盘面。

## 改动内容

**`src/DiscImageStudio.Core`**

- `ProjectDocument` 新增可选的 `cdExtra` 字段（模式开关和按播放顺序排列的音乐路径，最多 98 首）。带该字段的工程写为 schemaVersion 3，其余工程仍为 2。版本号由 `ProjectJsonStore.RequiredSchemaVersion` 按内容推导，保存和读取共用这一条规则。旧版本遇到不认识的字段会直接拒绝，所以只要字段存在就必须写 3。

**`src/DiscImageStudio.Iso`**

- `Iso9660ImageWriter` 新增 `lbaBias`，按 `mkisofs -C` 的约定把卷空间大小、路径表、目录和文件 extent 写成整盘绝对 LBA。偏移为 0 时输出与原来逐字节一致。

**`src/DiscImageStudio.Cd`**

- `CdExtraLayout`：按 Track-at-Once 计算音轨起点、区段间隔（导出区 6,750 + 导入区 4,500 + 预间隙 150 = 11,400 扇区）和数据轨范围，以及各区的半径与面积占比。
- `CdMusicFile`：读取 44.1 kHz、16 位、立体声 PCM WAV（含 WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE），样本原样输出，补到整扇区和 4 秒下限。
- `CdDataImageGenerator`：`CdDataLayoutPlan` 的 LBA 改为绝对地址，新增 `PrepareSessionLayout`；第 2 区段图片与整盘绘图在相同绝对 LBA 上逐字节一致。新增 `cd-extra-v1` 元数据。
- `cd-generate`、`cd-preview-warp` 新增 `--music` 与 `--session2-start-lba`（也接受 `cdrecord -msinfo` 的原样输出）。没有新增模块 ID 或命令名。

**`src/DiscImageStudio.Burning`**（刻录层契约变化）

- 新增独立的能力接口 `ICdExtraBurner`（`BurnCdExtraAsync`），由 `WindowsImapiBurner` 实现；`IOpticalDiscBurner` 不变。`OpticalBurnProgress` 新增可选的 `SectorBytes`。
- 写入通过 `IDiscRecorder2Ex` 发送原始 MMC 命令（`CdMmcCommands`、`CdTaoWriter`、`ICdExtraSession`）：MODE SELECT 05h 页设为 Track-at-Once 与多区段，逐首 WRITE(10) 写入音频并关闭第 1 区段，读取下一可写地址，**按该实测地址**生成第 2 区段数据，写入后封盘。起点差一个扇区会让图片旋转约 16°–37°，所以图片必须在第 1 区段关闭后才生成。
- 下一可写地址先查 READ DISC INFORMATION 给出的最后一轨；得到的不是可写的空白轨时，改查 FFh 不可见轨（cdrecord、libburn 的做法）。
- 支持不改变盘片的模拟写入。失败或取消后只排空缓存，不关闭区段。记录与其他刻录路径相同的写前环境、设备、盘片和速度信息。

**`src/DiscImageStudio.App`**

- 设计页新增「音乐（CD-Extra）」卡片：添加、排序、删除 WAV，显示时长和三个区域的半径、占比；画布、影调和预览页标出音乐区与区段间隔。
- 导出页输出第 2 区段 ISO，可填写外部刻录后实测的第 2 区段起点。刻录页写入两个区段，并提供「模拟写入」。
- 新增 `Localization/Catalogs/CdExtra.json`（zh-CN 与 en）。

**测试与文档**

- 新增三组回归（`--test-cd-extra`，完整回归也会运行）：布局与镜像、刻录命令序列（命令级 CD-R 模型，无硬件）、界面。
- 更新 `CHANGELOG.md`、七个 README、`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`、`docs/CD_AUDIO_COMPATIBILITY.md`、`docs/VALIDATION.md`。

## 设计说明

- **为什么不用 IMAPI 的 Track-at-Once 格式对象或现有 DAO 路径**：前者不能在保留追加的情况下关闭音乐区段后再写一条数据轨；DAO 需要在写入前给出整盘内容，而第 2 区段的内容取决于第 1 区段关闭后光驱报告的地址。所以直接发送 MMC 命令，做法与现有 BD-R 顺序写入一致。上游把普通 CD 刻录从 Track-at-Once 改为 DAO 的决定不受影响，`burn-build-info` 的检查仍然通过。
- **与 BD MMC 代码的重复**：有几处相似的辅助代码（执行并检查 sense、等待就绪、读流）。两者的重试规则和超时不同；为了不在本 PR 里改动已经实盘验证过的 BD 代码，暂时没有抽取公共部分。
- **Mode 1 而不是 XA**：正式的 Enhanced CD 要求第 2 区段使用 CD-ROM XA 和 `CDPLUS` 目录结构。这里写的是 Mode 1 数据轨，属于“音乐区段 + 数据区段”的多区段盘；文档已说明。

## 行为变化

- 不使用 CD-Extra 时，CD／DVD／BD 的生成与刻录输出不变。
- 两处与 CD-Extra 无直接关系的变化，均有回归覆盖：CD 工程清除随盘文件夹后恢复此前选择的 `.wav` 或 `.raw`，不再一律改回 `.wav`；`CdWaveFile.ReadAudioRange` 同时接受 WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE 封装的 16 位 PCM。
- 带 `cdExtra` 字段的工程（schemaVersion 3）不能被旧版本打开，旧版本会提示版本不受支持。

## 验证

本地验证都在 Windows 上完成；我没有 macOS 和 Linux 的本地环境，这两个平台只有 CI 的结果。

- `dotnet build DiscImageStudio.slnx --configuration Release`：0 警告，0 错误。
- `dotnet run --project src/DvdImageSolver --configuration Release -- selftest`：通过。
- `dotnet run --project tests/DiscImageStudio.ArchitectureTests --configuration Release`：`architecture-selftest: all checks passed`。
- GUI：示例工程的设计、导出、刻录页在 zh-CN 与 en 下离屏截图并人工检查。
- GitHub Actions：以本 PR 的 `build` 检查为准。

### 实盘

用程序内刻录实刻过一张盘（香蕉 CD-R 700 MB，两首音乐共 9 分 36 秒，24×）：

- CD 机 Syitern R300 播放音乐正常；在第 1 首开头继续快退停在 0:00，进不了图片所在的第 2 区段。
- 盘面图片的位置和方向与设计页一致。
- 日志：音轨起点 LBA 0 与 22636；预测与光驱报告的第 2 区段起点同为 LBA 54785；关闭第 1 区段约 30 秒。
- 尚未记录：刻录机型号与固件、模拟写入、电脑读取第 2 区段。目前只有一台刻录机的结果。

## 风险与说明

- 程序内 CD-Extra 刻录标记为实验性；写入速度通过 IMAPI 格式对象设置，数据通过原始 WRITE(10) 发送，这一组合目前只在一台刻录机上实刻成功。
- 预计的第 2 区段起点只用于设计预览；实际刻录始终以光驱报告的地址为准。
- 译文：`CdExtra.json` 只提供 zh-CN 与 en；其余语言的 README 条目由我翻译，欢迎母语者修订。

---

## Summary

Add CD-Extra (music + picture): the music is written as CD-DA tracks in session 1 on the inner rings, and the picture becomes one Mode 1 data track in session 2 on the outer rings. An audio CD player reads only session 1, so it plays the music and never the picture. The design page can add WAV music and shows by area how much of the disc the music, the session gap and the picture take.

## Changes

- **Core**: `ProjectDocument` gains an optional `cdExtra` block (mode switch and up to 98 music paths). A project that carries it is written as schemaVersion 3, all others stay at 2. One function, `ProjectJsonStore.RequiredSchemaVersion`, derives the version from the content for saving and loading. Older builds reject any member they do not know, so the block always needs version 3.
- **Iso**: `Iso9660ImageWriter` takes an `lbaBias` and writes whole-disc absolute LBAs (the `mkisofs -C` convention). With bias 0 the output is byte-identical to before.
- **Cd**: `CdExtraLayout` plans the Track-at-Once track starts, the 11,400-sector session gap and the data track. `CdMusicFile` reads 44.1 kHz 16-bit stereo PCM WAV unchanged and pads to whole sectors and four seconds. `CdDataImageGenerator` plans and draws a later-session volume at its absolute address, byte-identical to whole-disc drawing. `cd-generate` and `cd-preview-warp` gain `--music` and `--session2-start-lba`.
- **Burning** (contract change): a separate capability interface `ICdExtraBurner`, implemented by `WindowsImapiBurner`; `IOpticalDiscBurner` is unchanged. `OpticalBurnProgress` gains an optional `SectorBytes`. The writer sends raw MMC commands through `IDiscRecorder2Ex`: Track-at-Once with multi-session, WRITE(10) per track, close session 1, read the next writable address, generate the session 2 data **for that measured address**, write it and close the disc. The next writable track is the last track READ DISC INFORMATION names, with the invisible track (FFh) as a fallback. A test write is available.
- **App**: a "Music (CD-Extra)" card on the design page, the session 2 ISO export with an optional measured start, and the two-session burn with an optional test write.
- **Tests and documentation**: three new suites (`--test-cd-extra`), none of which needs a recorder; changelog, READMEs and docs updated.

## Design notes

- The IMAPI Track-at-Once format object cannot close the music session as appendable and then write a data track, and DAO needs the whole disc up front while session 2 depends on the address reported after session 1 is closed. Hence raw MMC commands, as the BD-R writer already uses. Ordinary CD burning stays on DAO and `burn-build-info` still passes.
- A few MMC helpers resemble the BD ones; retry rules and timeouts differ, and the BD code that has been verified on hardware is left untouched in this PR.
- Session 2 is a Mode 1 data track, not CD-ROM XA with a `CDPLUS` directory, so this is a multi-session music + data disc rather than a formal Enhanced CD. The documentation says so.

## Behaviour changes

- Without CD-Extra, CD, DVD and BD output is unchanged.
- Two changes are not specific to CD-Extra and are covered by regressions: clearing the disc-file folder of a CD project restores the previously chosen `.wav` or `.raw` output, and `CdWaveFile.ReadAudioRange` also accepts 16-bit PCM in the WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE container.
- Projects with a `cdExtra` block (schemaVersion 3) are reported as unsupported by older builds.

## Validation

Everything local was done on Windows. I have no macOS or Linux machine, so those platforms are covered by CI only.

- Release solution build: 0 warnings, 0 errors. DVD `selftest`: passed. Full architecture suite: `architecture-selftest: all checks passed`.
- GUI: design, export and burn pages of a sample project captured off-screen in zh-CN and en and inspected.
- GitHub Actions: see the `build` check of this PR.

### Physical disc

One disc has been burned with the in-app writer (Banana CD-R 700 MB, two tracks, 9 min 36 s, 24x):

- A Syitern R300 CD player plays the music normally; rewinding at the start of track 1 stops at 0:00 and cannot reach the picture in session 2.
- The picture on the disc matches the design page in position and orientation.
- Log: track starts at LBA 0 and 22636; predicted and reported session 2 start both LBA 54785; closing session 1 took about 30 s.
- Not recorded yet: recorder model and firmware, a test write, reading session 2 on a computer. This is one recorder only.

## Risks and notes

- In-app CD-Extra burning is marked experimental. Setting the speed through the IMAPI format object while writing with raw WRITE(10) has worked on one recorder so far.
- The predicted session 2 start is used for design previews only; a real burn always uses the address the recorder reports.
- `CdExtra.json` provides zh-CN and en only; I translated the README entries for the other languages, and corrections from native speakers are welcome.

title: Add Optional PGP Signatures to Release Assets
body:
## Changes

This PR adds optional PGP file signing to the CI release workflow. Once the corresponding PGP private key is configured, CI will generate digital signatures for release assets during the release process.

This feature is **optional**. If the required key is not configured, CI will automatically skip the signing steps without affecting the existing release workflow.

## Tools and Configuration

- **Tool:** [Sequoia PGP](https://sequoia-pgp.org/)
- **Configuration:** Set `RELEASE_SIGN_KEY` in GitHub Actions Secrets. Its value should be the PGP private key used for signing.
- **Compatibility:** The signing functionality is implemented using Sequoia PGP and supports signing with OpenPGP private keys generated by GnuPG.

## Post-Quantum Signing Keys

Sequoia PGP supports **standardized** post-quantum signature algorithms such as ML-DSA when using the OpenSSL cryptographic backend and an underlying OpenSSL version that supports the corresponding algorithms. OpenSSL **3.5.0** or later is recommended.

For users who wish to experiment with post-quantum signatures, the following command generates a key using the hybrid ML-DSA-65 and Ed25519 signing algorithm:

```bash
sq key generate --own-key \
  --signing-algorithm mldsa65-ed25519 \
  --profile rfc9580 \
  --name <your name> \
  --email <your email> \
  --output <path to save the private key> \
  --rev-cert <path to save the revocation certificate>
```

**Compatibility Notes:**

As of November 10, 2026, GnuPG does not yet support the post-quantum signature algorithms mentioned above. In addition, there are still some interoperability limitations between GnuPG and [RFC 9580](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9580.html). Therefore, if interoperability with GnuPG is required, traditional signature algorithms are currently recommended.

Please note that the post-quantum support of keys generated using the command above currently applies only to digital signatures. Other operations, such as public-key encryption, still rely on traditional cryptographic algorithms. Therefore, the entire cryptographic process should not be considered post-quantum secure.

If needed, you can also add the `--encryption-algorithm mlkem768-x25519` parameter when generating a key to enable post-quantum public-key encryption. However, this algorithm may increase the size of the private key file, potentially causing it to exceed the GitHub Actions Secrets size limit and making it impossible to store directly.

In theory, Sequoia PGP is compatible with private and public keys from other PGP implementations that support [RFC 4880](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4880.html), [RFC 9580](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9580.html), and [RFC 9980](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9980.html).

As of November 10, 2026, I have not yet tested private and public keys generated by other PGP implementations. However, I have verified that traditional, pre-quantum private and public keys generated by GnuPG can be processed by Sequoia PGP.

**Why Sequoia PGP Instead of GnuPG?**

GnuPG does not yet support post-quantum signatures. As of [GnuPG 2.5.24](https://lists.gnupg.org/pipermail/gnupg-announce/2026q3/000516.html), it only supports using [Kyber](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/203/final) for public-key encryption to protect against *Harvest Now, Decrypt Later* attacks.

Furthermore, GnuPG does not interoperate with [RFC 9580](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9580.html) and [RFC 9980](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9980.html), or has limited interoperability with them.

To maintain compatibility with a wider range of PGP software currently available, while also ensuring that the software used for signing has memory safety to the greatest extent possible, this PR uses Sequoia PGP, which is written in Rust.

*To my knowledge, Red Hat has already adopted Sequoia PGP for [signing RPM packages](https://docs.redhat.com/zh-cn/documentation/red_hat_enterprise_linux/10/html/packaging_and_distributing_software/configuring-rpm-for-sequoia). This is also one of the reasons I chose this signing tool for this PR.*

### CI Environment and Build Configuration Changes

To support post-quantum signatures, this PR also makes adjustments to the CI environment and the way Sequoia PGP is built.

The `sq` package provided by the Ubuntu repositories uses the Nettle cryptographic backend by default, whereas Sequoia PGP's current support for post-quantum algorithms depends on the OpenSSL backend.

Therefore, instead of using the `sq` package provided by the distribution, CI builds Sequoia SQ from source using Cargo when signing is required, explicitly enabling the `crypto-openssl` feature.

To avoid repeated builds, **`actions/cache` is used to cache the Sequoia SQ binary** in CI. You can delete the corresponding cache under Actions -> Management -> Cache to trigger a fresh Sequoia SQ build during the next release.

Additionally, the GitHub Actions runner environment has been changed from `ubuntu-latest` to `ubuntu-26.04` to use OpenSSL 3.5.x provided by Ubuntu 26.04, which is required for support of post-quantum algorithms such as ML-DSA.

All of the above build and signing steps are optional and are executed only when `RELEASE_SIGN_KEY` is configured. If no key is configured, Sequoia SQ will not be built, and the existing release workflow will remain unaffected.

## Notes

The documentation and some of the code in this PR were prepared with assistance from ChatGPT and DeepSeek, and tested using GitHub Actions in my forked repository.

**To avoid code conflicts, PGP signature verification for release assets has not yet been added to the in-app auto-update functionality.** If signature verification is to be integrated into the auto-update functionality, possible approaches include using wrapper or binding to call libraries provided by Sequoia PGP to verify signatures, or bundling `sq` into the distributed binary and invoking it through the command line to verify signatures.

To further improve release security, you may also consider enabling **Immutable Releases**.

By the way, for an explanation of the command used to export the public key, you can refer to the official Sequoia PGP documentation. The `sq key delete` command used here can be somewhat misleading and is easy to misunderstand.

```
# Export Public Key
sq key delete \
  --cert-file private_key.pgp \
  --output release/public_key.asc
```

The original documentation explains it as follows:

> For example, if you work in stateless mode and manage keys only in files (and not the keystore), one way to extract the certificate from a key is to delete the secret key material from that file. If you want to retain both parts, make a copy of the key beforehand.

https://book.sequoia-pgp.org/revocation.html#delete-a-key

For a demonstration of the actual results of this PR, you can check out the test release I created in my forked repository:

https://github.com/jinnang233/DiscImageStudio/releases/tag/v1.5.0

Thank you for taking the time to review this PR. I welcome any feedback or suggestions.

title: Add measured Verbatim CD-R Extra Protection preset
body:
## Summary

Adds a measured CD-R geometry preset for **Verbatim CD-R Extra Protection**, manufactured by CMC Magnetics (ATIP `97:26:66`). The preset was derived from CD-DA read-timing measurements using `disc-probe` and successfully tested on **CD-R discs**.

## Measurement details

- **Disc:** Verbatim CD-R Extra Protection (43347)
- **ATIP:** `97:26:66` (CMC Magnetics)
- **Drive:** TSSTcorp CDDVDW SU-228GB
- **Firmware:** AS00
- **Measurement method:** CD-DA timing analysis using `disc-probe`
- **Measurement points:** 36/36
- **Angular fit RMS:** 0.172°

### Geometry

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---:|
| Sectors | 359844 |
| Usable sectors | 359842 |
| Inner radius | 25.276144212110722 mm |
| Outer radius | 58.28306795541299 mm |
| Linear velocity | 1200 mm/s |
| Pitch linear | 2.5851954651236925e-09 |
| Pitch quadratic | -5.91768627050507e-10 |
| Pitch cubic | -2.6989935400056038e-09 |

## Physical validation

The preset was tested on CD-R discs using the same recording drive. On the discs produced visible artwork with the measured geometry. A diagnostic target containing radial lines and concentric circles showed no obvious geometric distortion under visual inspection. By comparison, the default CD geometry had previously failed to produce recognizable artwork on this media and drive combination.

## Limitations

- The READ CD offset was assumed to be zero and was not independently calibrated.
- The fitted radii describe an effective CD-DA timing geometry, this is not independently measured physical track boundaries.
- Validation was performed with one drive model. Compatibility with other drives, batches, or CD-R manufacturers is not established.

## Changes

- Added a measured CD-R preset to `built-in-disc-presets.json`.
- Preserved the full-precision fitted geometry parameters.

title: 引入随盘外圈刻录出血功能
body:
- 针对 #312，在随盘文件放到外圈且开启「外缘出血」时，将可写容量收紧到总扇区的 95%，并向下对齐到可写单元（CD 1 / DVD 16 / BD 32）。
- 出血只影响生成、导出、刻录、预览和数据区导引的有效容量；工程持久化与标定仍使用原始容量。
- 切换出血会刷新设计画布、数据区导引和影调预览，并计入工程脏状态；刻录任务标识也包含该开关，避免复用旧参数。
- 新增 `OuterRingBleedTests`，覆盖容量上限、门控、持久化、sidecar 采纳、设计导引以及 CD/DVD/BD 输出。
- 针对 #289 新增 `HybridDrawingParityTests`，逐字节验证纯绘图、内圈文件、外圈文件在共同绝对 LBA 上的绘图数据一致。没有实际的产品代码改动。
- README 打磨。

Refs #312, #289, #61
